salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It lets the room be built around where people and displays need to be, rather than where short cables happen to reach.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Displays away from the rack, lecterns, teaching rooms, meeting rooms and point-to-point signal paths.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Start with distance and what has to travel: video only, video plus USB, audio, control or network.
talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
Use it when the video path needs reliable point-to-point extension.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.
discoveryPrompts: How far is the source from the display or USB device?

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

Compact Class B HDBaseT receiver supporting 4K HDR transmissions up to 35 meters from a compatible HDBaseT matrix or presentation switcher. 2-way PoH allows the RX-35-POH to power over category cable from a PoH matrix or switcher and also allows for the receiver to power in-wall HDBaseT transmitters.

Small in size but not in specification, the RX-35-POH is no different to the modern H2 family of products, supporting pixel-perfect 4K UHD 4:2:0 10-bit @24Hz at distances up to 35m/115ft or 1080p to 35m/115ft.

Supports 3 methods of control pass-through. Being a pure HDBaseT TM device, the RX-35-POH can handle bi-directional IR, RS-232 and even CEC routing when used as part of a compatible WyreStorm matrix or extender system.
The RX-35-POH can be powered by a PoH compatible matrix or presentation switcher meaning one less thing to think about when specifying & installing a WyreStorm system.
2-way PoH enabled for convenient PSU-free installation
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | DVI/D supported with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
